text:
Maya P.: opened PR #2894 to patch a VPC routing mismatch for BlueOak private deploy — this is causing some cross-subnet reachability during canary. can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploy/pull/2894  
John C.: @Maya P. on it. will run the e2e and smoke tests, aiming to review in the next hour :eyes:
Liam O.: quick heads-up — the change adds a route replace, we'll need to run the followup migration on the customer's VPC (non-destructive dry-run included). command I used: `./scripts/apply-vpc.sh --customer blueoak --dry-run`
Sophia G.: looping in security review. preliminary check: KMS policy change in the PR, please add a note in the PR description about why the customer key needs kms:Decrypt for the migration step :lock:
Maya P.: good catch — added explanation and a short rollback plan in the PR description. also added the migration dry-run output for the staging VPC.
John C.: found a flaky assertion in the tests, pushed a fix to the branch (rebased). CI rerunning now. diff snippet: ```diff
- route: 0.0.0.0/0
+ route: 10.32.0.0/12
```
deploy-bot: deploy-window check: BlueOak scheduled cutover: 2025-11-02 22:00 UTC. current window closes in ~36h. merge must land before EOD tomorrow to make cutover.
Maya P.: noted — pressure to merge. can someone from infra approve the runtime change? @Liam O. you mentioned the migration; can you approve after you verify the dry-run?
Liam O.: verified dry-run logs, migration is safe. approving now. :white_check_mark:
Sophia G.: security ACK, KMS note added and IAM change scoped to customer key only. :lock_with_ink_pen:
John C.: merged after approvals and green CI. will follow up with post-merge smoke in staging.
Maya P.: thanks all — I pinged BlueOak SEs to confirm post-merge validation. will keep channel updated if anything pops up. :thumbsup:
